title: Find the names of superheroes who have an attribute value between 70 and 85
question: Find the names of superheroes who have an attribute value between 70 and 85, and whose height is greater than 80% of the average height of all superheroes. Among these, return only those whose strongest attribute (i.e., the one with the highest attribute_value) is 'Strength'.

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T2
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
    WHERE T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
      AND T2."XCL_011" BETWEEN 70 AND 85
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
    WHERE T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
      AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
      AND T4."XCL_011" = (
        SELECT MAX(T6."XCL_011")
        FROM hero_attribute AS T6
        WHERE T6."XCL_009" = T1."XCL_018"
      )
  )

FROM superhero AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T2
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
    WHERE T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
      AND T2."XCL_011" BETWEEN 70 AND 85
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
    WHERE T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
      AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
      AND T4."XCL_011" = (
        SELECT MAX(T6."XCL_011")
        FROM hero_attribute AS T6
        WHERE T6."XCL_009" = T1."XCL_018"
      )
  )

    WHERE T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
      AND T2."XCL_011" BETWEEN 70 AND 85
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
    WHERE T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
      AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
      AND T4."XCL_011" = (
        SELECT MAX(T6."XCL_011")
        FROM hero_attribute AS T6
        WHERE T6."XCL_009" = T1."XCL_018"
      )
  )
